replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thank you for your interest in Robb Report! The piece you are referring to is actually a Featured Property Listing. These are paid placements.

You'll note this property is included on the Featured Listing Carousel on Robb Report's Real Estate Page linked here<http://www.robbreport.com/real-estate>. We include up to 10 properties, each placement is guaranteed at least 10% share of the page.

Real Estate is Robb Report's most read content category among our ultra-high net worth audience.

Please let me know if you'd like to learn more about paid opportunities to highlight your services with us. Robb Report is owned by Penske Media Corporation (PMC). Our headquarters is in Los Angeles, which is one of our top markets.

Thank you, we hope to hear back from you soon.

My best,
Kristie


Kristie Nilsson Director, Real Estate & Travel

475 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10017
M 718.797.1880 knilsson@robbreport.com<mailto:carolineb@robbreport.com>











[signature_2492468022]


________________________________
From: Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la>
Sent: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 8:29 PM
To: Kristie Nilsson <knilsson@artnews.com>
Subject: A European angle on your A Private World above the Pacific. Natural beauty, timeless piece

Hi team,

Your piece on "A Private World above the Pacific" captured something
rare: a property that feels both monumental and quiet, where the ocean
does most of the talking. That balance between natural drama and
architectural restraint is exactly what drew us to this part of the
coast.

My Villa builds Italian-designed homes in Los Angeles using cemento a
vista, reinforced concrete left raw and honest, a technique rooted in
Mediterranean coastal architecture where structure and setting are
meant to coexist, not compete.

Given your eye for homes that respect their landscape, would you be
open to receiving more material, or a short call with our founder,
Paolo Mezzalama, about this approach.

Best,
Lisa Monelli
My Villa Media Team
info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
